scientific_guardrails: FIRMS remains the source of active-fire detections.
Weather and NDVI are context only and are not inputs to the MODIS-VIIRS harmonization model.
Weather values represent the region centroid, not each hotspot.
NDVI is a 16-day vegetation-greenness index, not fuel moisture or a fire-risk score.
Planetary Computer area statistics use a maximum processing dimension of 512 pixels.
Missing data are not filled with zero; simulated records remain explicitly labelled.
